findings.title: [P2] Describe Redis limits as phase and file limits, not total bounds
findings.body: DAT-009: The claimed total bounds are stronger than the primitive implements. In `scripts/redis-prepare-migration.sh`, snapshot hashing, `redis-check-rdb`, copying and final hashing/synchronization run outside a whole-command timeout. Each server startup receives a fresh `maximum_seconds` timeout; the shared deadline is checked only in polling loops. Likewise, `ulimit -f` limits individual files, while aggregate destination size is checked after conversion, so temporary disk use can exceed `maximum_bytes`. Operators cannot rely on these settings as a maintenance deadline or disk reservation ceiling. Document the actual enforcement and require sufficient conversion headroom and an independently bounded owner procedure where total limits are necessary.
